questions.stem_text: Women have been excluded from the public sphere because:

options.A: industrial capitalism separated the middle class home from the workplace
options.B: those who enter paid employment have been 'sidelined' into particular fields
options.C: it is difficult to succeed in 'malestream' politics without compromising their femininity

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text: The term inter-generational mobility refers to:

options.A: movement into a different occupational category over a person's lifetime
options.B: movement into different occupational categories between generations
options.C: movement into a higher occupational category
options.D: movement into an occupation that generates a lower income

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - movement into different occupational categories between generations

questions.stem_text: Murray thought that the 'underclass' consisted of people who:

options.A: formed an inferior 'race' with low levels of intelligence
options.B: lived morally unsound lives of crime and squalor
options.C: were too reliant upon welfare benefits

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text:
Which of these trends did the New Right not suggest as evidence of declining family
values?

options.A: the tendency for cohabitation before marriage
options.C: the absence of fathers in many households
options.D: the increasing number of single parent families

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the tendency for cohabitation before marriage
